author: Patrikano
body:
Hi!

This is pat. I am in a team called CrookArmy. The leader in that team is LeroyJenkins.

Today (14th august) He had been abusing his powers in a scrimmage.

Rule broken: Abusing Powers

Evidence:
http://imgur.com/a/ytsJT
I do not know if this is allowed or not. But don't the same rules apply on scrim?
I went a little over board with these screenshots. Take it as a movie :)
http://imgur.com/a/inMTh
And heres the last one with him using god apples
http://imgur.com/v3yn87U
Thanks!
-Pat

replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body: Were you scrimming another team, or was it an intra-squad scrim? (Scrimming with your own team.)
replies.body_tagged: Were you scrimming another team, or was it an intra-squad scrim? (Scrimming with your own team.)

replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Hello, 

Since this was a intra-squad scrim, I'm going to have to deny this. If he does this again, feel free to send in another report.

Thanks,
Vobaseball12, Moderator & Official
